## Active Work

**Currently In Progress:** None — **PHASE 3b IS CLOSED (6/6 · 16/16)**; the demo script runs
end to end, from the baseline through all three flows and their follow-ups to an off-script question
and Reset
**Blocked Stories:** none
**Next Up:** **US-040 — presentation sizing & responsiveness (3 pts)**, the opening of Phase 4. The
prototype is feature complete, so everything from here hardens it for the room. Seven patterns are
established for the rest of the build to copy: a
good/bad reading arrives from `derive.ts` as data and is never re-derived in a component; a recorded
review decision is expressed structurally so it cannot be reverted by accident; a shared seam is
widened rather than forked when a consumer needs slightly more (`HBarTile`'s `children`,
`DeltaChip`'s `suffix`, `CardCaption`'s `section` placement); and **pre-authored copy is rendered
verbatim** — US-024 asserts byte-identical output, which is the guarantee every Phase 3b narrative
depends on; and **a debounce is state, not a clock** — US-028 consumes the question through a
mirrored ref and closes the field on `busy`, so the only pending timer in the app is still
US-015's `schedule`; and **state that can be derived is derived** — US-029's chip row is a pure
function of `sections`, which is what closed US-015's chip criterion with no reset code at all; and
**one rule lives in one place and is pinned there by a source scan** — US-033's gate is the only
reader of `hasSection`, so gating and chip visibility can never drift into two states; and **a
breakdown must reconcile with the row it explains** — US-039's badge is summed from the rows on
screen and asserted equal to Marketing's derived variance, so the beat cannot claim to explain more
or less of the overspend than it shows
